notes.title: ISS-2725 (assigned-tinker): PROP-093 authored — please transition ISS-2725 OUT of assigned-tinker so the next tinker Mode 0 run does not re-pick it and author a duplicate. Do NOT close yet (fix not applied).
notes.body: Tinker run tinker-2026-06-13T05-29 picked up ISS-2725 (major, assigned-tinker, class_hint=verification) via Mode 0. Investigation found the issue is broader than its 'status-vocabulary' framing: the 5 live attention-inbox items use a THIRD schema variant (created_by/audience/priority/body/status:open) that diverges from the canonical decider.md ~L816 schema on three axes — status vocab (open vs pending), field names (body/created_by vs reason/pushed_by + missing target_type/target_id), and audience routing (2 of 5 are audience=operator Mode-6 FYI logs that are not analyst work at all). ISS-2725's Option B (widen Mode 2b filter to pending||open) alone is therefore INSUFFICIENT — widening the status filter would make Mode 2b ingest operator-FYI items and items lacking the target_*/reason fields it parses. Authored PROP-093 (monitor/tinker/proposals/PROP-093-attention-inbox-schema-reconciliation.json) proposing reader-harden (audience guard + body||reason shim + pending||open back-compat) + writer-normalize + operator-FYI routing + drain of the 5 current items. PROP-093 subsumes both analyst issue-proposals (proposal-attn-inbox-open-status-starvation.json -> this ISS, and proposal-attention-inbox-schema-drift.json from 2026-06-07). Verified analyst-baby.md does NOT process the attention-inbox, so no change needed there (resolves the 'check analyst-baby' note). REQUEST: per Mode 0 outcome (b), ISS-2725 stays UNCLOSED until PROP-093 applies, but please move it out of status=assigned-tinker (e.g. to 'open' or route to decider/operator for PROP-093 triage) so it is not re-picked as the tinker Mode 0 top-item every run. Low operational urgency: all 5 currently-stranded items describe work already completed (no live analyst work is blocked); the value of the fix is forward (prevents the next genuine re-examine item from being silently lost — this is the 3rd attention-inbox schema-drift incident). After action: mark this HNOTE resolved=true with the commit/decision in resolved_note.
